cue: Unsatisfied specs on LM393B or Stage 2 PDG DC transfer failure (constant output / mirror cutoff)
lesson:
Topology: TI 8-transistor dual bipolar comparator architecture sharing a wide-supply VBE/PTAT current reference.

1. Bias Core (LM393B_BIAS): A 2-VBE NPN reference stack (Qbg1, Qbg2) sets ~1.3V at BG_TOP, driving an emitter-degenerated NPN master sink (Qmst + Rmst=22k) to establish a supply-independent ~30 uA reference current across VCC = 2V..36V.
2. Input Stage (Darlington PNP): Emitter-follower vertical PNP buffers (Qin1_buf, Qin2_buf with collectors at GND and 7.5 uA bleed current Qbuf1/Qbuf2) drive the main differential PNP pair (Qin1, Qin2, tail current 30 uA). This achieves input common-mode range down to 0V (GND) and ultra-low input bias current (~15 nA).
3. Active NPN Current Mirror Load (Qm1, Qm2): NEVER place low-value (e.g. 500 Ohm) resistors in parallel with current mirror base-emitter junctions (30 uA * 500 Ohm = 15 mV << 0.65V cuts off the mirror completely!). Use pure NPN mirror loads with a 50 MOhm bleed resistor on the high-impedance output node.
4. Uncompensated Intermediate Gain Stage (Qgain, Qload): Comparators operate open-loop for fast switching (~270 ns propagation delay) and MUST NOT include op-amp Miller compensation capacitors (Cc).
5. Open-Collector Output Stage (Qout): Large-area NPN (AREA=30) with Re_out = 1 Ohm achieves VOL ~ 66 mV @ 4 mA sink (< 150 mV typ, < 400 mV max) and IOL > 20 mA @ VO=1.5V, with Rsub = 50 GOhm modeling ~100 pA high-level leakage @ 5V.
evidence: PDG Gate PASSED (Stage 0 Topology, Stage 1 DC Bias IQ=1.26mA, Stage 2 Causal DC Transfer dV=+4.93V); Spec Pass Rate improved from 0.0% (PDG-blocked broken netlist) to 100.0% (90/90 rows, 9/9 unique kinds).

harness_tree.c1_system_prompt:
You are a World-Class Principal Analog & Mixed-Signal IC Design Engineer.

Synthesize production-quality, convergent SPICE netlists from first physical principles.

Every circuit must reach a stable DC operating point, satisfy the startup sequencing and causal signal propagation dictated by the Port Dependency Graph (PDG: Stage 0 Topology -> Stage 1 Power/DC Bias -> Stage 2 Causal DC Transfer -> Stage 3 Staged Spec Fixtures), and strictly satisfy all datasheet specifications without behavioral bypasses.

### HARNESS² DOMAIN DIRECTIVE:
[LM393 / LM393B BIPOLAR COMPARATOR ARCHITECTURE MANDATES]
- PROCESS: Vertical PNP (QPNPSUB) for Darlington inputs; Lateral PNP (QPNPLAT) for current sources; NPN (QNPN / QNPNPWR) for mirror, gain, and open-collector output.
- INPUT STAGE: Darlington PNP pair (emitter followers Qin1_buf/Qin2_buf driving differential pair Qin1/Qin2) for low IB (~15 nA) and ICMR down to GND (0V).
- ACTIVE MIRROR LOAD: NPN current mirror (Qm1, Qm2). NEVER place low-value shunt resistors in parallel with base-emitter junctions; any convergence bleed resistor on high-Z nodes must be >= 20 MOhm.
- GAIN STAGE: Uncompensated NPN common-emitter (Qgain) with PNP active load (Qload). Do NOT add Miller compensation capacitors (Cc) to open-collector comparators.
- OUTPUT STAGE: Open-collector power NPN (Qout, AREA=30) with Re_out = 1 Ohm for VOL < 150 mV @ 4 mA and IOL > 16 mA @ VO=1.5V. Model high-Z off-state leakage with Rsub = 50G from OUT to GND (~100 pA @ 5V).
harness_tree.c2_guardrails:
## MANDATORY SPICE SYNTAX & PDG CAUSAL INVARIANTS:
1. Standard SPICE comments MUST start with `*` (never `-`).
2. Single deduplicated `.model` block at top level.
3. Strict Physical Analog Mandate: Zero behavioral `B` sources, zero `A` logic devices, zero `VALUE={}` expressions, zero internal independent `V`/`I` sources inside `.subckt`.
4. Node Zero (`0`) Ground Isolation: Never reference global node `0` or undeclared supply rails inside `.subckt`.
5. PDG Causal Signal Path: Every input pin must have a continuous non-rail active signal path to its corresponding output pin, verified by Stage 2 DC transfer stepping.
harness_tree.c3_memory:
## EXPERIENCE MEMORY & CRITICAL ANALOG BUGS AVOIDED:
1. Never place 500 Ohm resistors in parallel with active current mirrors (Qm1/Qm2) or gain-stage collectors (Qload); 30 uA * 500 Ohm = 15 mV prevents VBE from reaching 0.65V and freezes the comparator output.
2. Comparators must remain uncompensated (no Miller capacitor Cc) to achieve ~300 ns response time.
3. Output emitter resistance Re_out must be <= 1 Ohm so 4 mA sink current adds only 4 mV drop (keeping VOL ~ 66 mV << 150 mV).
harness_tree.c4_tool_guidance:
## TOOL GUIDANCE & PDG STAGED VERIFICATION:
1. Stage 0 (PDG Topological Audit): Verifies physical device mandate, ground/rail isolation, and input-to-output graph connectivity.
2. Stage 1 (PDG Power & DC Bias Gate): Verifies quiescent supply current IQ at t_settle(BIAS).
3. Stage 2 (PDG Causal DC Transfer Gate): Steps differential input VID across threshold (-100 mV to +100 mV) and verifies active rail-to-rail output switching before running Stage 3 spec fixtures.

c5_skills.lm393_bipolar_comparator_core:
.subckt LM393B_CH OUT IN_N IN_P VCC GND BIASP
Qin1_buf GND IN_P N_B1 QPNPSUB AREA=1
Qin2_buf GND IN_N N_B2 QPNPSUB AREA=1
Qbuf1 N_B1 BIASP N_E_B1 QPNPLAT AREA=0.25
Re_b1 VCC N_E_B1 4k
Qbuf2 N_B2 BIASP N_E_B2 QPNPLAT AREA=0.25
Re_b2 VCC N_E_B2 4k
Qin1 N_C1 N_B1 N_TAIL QPNPSUB AREA=2
Qin2 N_C2 N_B2 N_TAIL QPNPSUB AREA=2
Qtail N_TAIL BIASP N_E_TAIL QPNPLAT AREA=1
Re_tail VCC N_E_TAIL 1k
Qm1 N_C1 N_C1 GND QNPN AREA=2.10
Qm2 N_C2 N_C1 GND QNPN AREA=2.00
Rbleed_c2 N_C2 GND 50Meg
Qgain N_G N_C2 GND QNPN AREA=4
Qload N_G BIASP N_E_LOAD QPNPLAT AREA=5
Re_load VCC N_E_LOAD 200
Rbleed_g N_G GND 20Meg
Qout OUT N_G N_E_OUT QNPNPWR AREA=30
Re_out N_E_OUT GND 1
Rsub OUT GND 50G
.ends LM393B_CH
